description: Repo foundation and gatekeeper safety core (PLAN.md items 1-7). Lands .gitattributes first, the first three idempotent provision.sh steps (users, apt-base, uv) run for real in the existing 'ossbot' distro to create the dev environment (ossadmin uid 1000, pinned uv at /opt/ossbot/bin/uv, shellcheck, gitleaks), the uv project with pinned deps, ossbot.common, and the deterministic gatekeeper core: SQLite schema of DESIGN §12.7, control state (running/paused/killed soft|full, dry-run default ON), hash-chained audit with anchors client, state machine with actor table and live-PR redirect (§9.2), approval binding/lifecycle/invalidation and message-bound ui_tokens (§12.4), policy with monotonic floors (§12.6, §7.9), rate limits, config snapshot, UDS API with SO_PEERCRED roles (§12.2, no approve endpoint), outbox. First FEAT; everything else depends on it.
steps: Item 1: add .gitattributes (* text=auto eol=lf; *.ps1 text eol=crlf; binaries binary), extend .gitignore (.pytest_cache/ .mypy_cache/ .ruff_cache/ *.egg-info/), git add --renormalize ., commit alone.

Item 2: write scripts/provision.sh (step registry in DESIGN §18.2 order, --only/--list, changed/unchanged output, log to /srv/ossbot/logs/provision-<ts>.log), scripts/lib/common.sh and scripts/lib/users.sh; implement steps 'users' (all users/groups/uids/dirs/modes of §7.3; ossadmin uid 1000 with ~/.profile PATH and UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT; ossnobody 1001; /etc/sudoers.d/ossbot-ossadmin NOPASSWD only for /opt/ossbot/bin/* and /opt/ossbot/app/.venv/bin/ossctl, PLAN Decision 3), 'apt-base' (§18.2 packages + shellcheck; gitleaks release sha256-verified to /usr/local/bin) and 'uv' (pinned tarball sha256 from versions.lock). Create config/versions.lock.yaml with the DESIGN §0 pins after re-checking each by web search. Run: (Get-Content -Raw scripts/provision.sh) -replace "`r","" | wsl.exe -d ossbot -u root -- bash -s -- --only users,apt-base,uv (twice).

Item 3: pyproject.toml (requires-python >=3.12,<3.14; == pins per PLAN Decision 4; console script ossbot-gatekeeper; pytest markers with --strict-markers; ruff; mypy strict for ossbot.gatekeeper/dockerfilter/common; import-linter contracts of §18.1), uv lock, src/ossbot/common/{config,snapshot,paths,logging,clock,ids,yamlio,uds,redact,hashing,schemas,rediscover}.py, config/{policy,egress,targets}.yaml (targets from §17.2, neutral why texts), config/profile.example.yaml (placeholders only), tests/fixtures/profile.test.yaml, tests/conftest.py, tests/unit/common/test_*.py incl. test_snapshot_hash.py (N2).

Item 4: src/ossbot/gatekeeper/{db.py,control.py,audit.py,anchors.py,anomaly.py} + migrations/0001_init.sql verbatim from §12.7; tests test_audit.py (incl. test_recomputed_chain_fails_against_anchors) and test_control_reconcile.py (N12, resume.log offset N4).

Item 5: state_machine.py, approvals.py, policy.py, ratelimit.py, snapshot load/reload with confirm hash; tests test_state_machine.py, test_approvals.py (all non-git cases), test_policy.py, test_policy_floor.py, test_ratelimit.py, test_snapshot.py, test_discover.py, test_control.py parametrized over a shared stage/job/outbound-kind constant x {paused, killed}.

Item 6: authz.py (peercred uid -> operator/worker/sandbox/requester; others 403), app.py/main.py (uvicorn on /run/ossbot/gatekeeper.sock, ossapi 0660), api/{control,config,contributions,actions,models,audit,notify}.py with every §12.2 endpoint (package/import/import-bundle return 501 until FEAT-002), operator FYI hook, outbox.py (pluggable sender); tests test_authz.py (route table has no approve route), test_api_uds.py (temp UDS), test_catalog_upsert.py (R4-N3).
Item 7: run the full FEAT verification, set this file's status to completed, record findings, commit locally (identity check first).
acceptance_criteria: git ls-files --eol shows LF in the index for every text file; .gitattributes committed in its own first commit

provision.sh --only users,apt-base,uv prints changed on first run and unchanged on the second; ossadmin is uid 1000 in groups sudo, osscfg, ossapi; /opt/ossbot/bin/uv --version and gitleaks version print the pinned versions

DEV pytest -m unit passes with the DESIGN §22.1 cases for state machine (AC 19: worker gets 403 on every approval-state edge), approvals (every single-field binding change, dry-run toggle both directions, AC 6), rate limits (AC 11), control x {paused, killed} (AC 10), audit anchors (AC 16), policy floors, snapshot hash N2, authz (no approve route)
ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy (strict packages), lint-imports all pass; shellcheck clean on scripts/provision.sh and scripts/lib/*.sh
No personal values in tracked files outside docs/ (profile.example.yaml has placeholders only)

(peeled commit still pending, FEAT-007), kind 0.33.0, tofu 1.13.1, age 1.3.2 (sha256s pending until installed). DEVIATION: docker-ce newest is 5:29.9.1-1~ubuntu.24.04~noble (not 29.8.2), containerd.io 2.4.2-2, buildx 0.38.0-1, compose plugin 5.6.0-1 (major 5); lock updated, ADR-0001 addendum. PyPI pins (==, PLAN Decision 4): fastapi 0.143.3, uvicorn 0.54.0, pydantic 2.14.1, httpx 0.28.1, python-telegram-bot 22.8, ruamel.yaml 0.19.1, jinja2 3.1.6, typer 0.27.3, h11 0.16.0; dev pytest 9.1.1, pytest-asyncio 1.4.0, respx 0.23.1, hypothesis 6.170.1, ruff 0.17.1, mypy 2.4.0, import-linter 2.15; build backend uv_build==0.13.1; [tool.uv] required-version ==0.13.1. DISTRO STATE: provision.sh --only users,apt-base,uv applied (first run changed, second unchanged). ossadmin uid 1000 (sudo, osscfg 1500, ossapi), ossnobody 1001 (no groups), system users gatekeeper/ossrunner/ossbox/hermes with user-private groups; dirs of DESIGN 7.3 created; /etc/sudoers.d/ossbot-ossadmin NOPASSWD only /opt/ossbot/bin/* and /opt/ossbot/app/.venv/bin/ossctl (visudo OK); ~/.profile managed block (PATH, UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT); shellcheck 0.9.0 (apt) + gitleaks at /usr/local/bin; sudo added to the apt-base list. Until FEAT-004 the repo is on the default automount (root:root 0777), so ossadmin can write it. PROVISION.SH: step registry OSSBOT_STEPS in 18.2 order ('name|function|skip reason'); unimplemented steps print 'skipped (...)'; new lib files must be added to the install line that copies scripts/lib/*.sh to a root-only temp dir before sourcing; helpers in lib/common.sh (ensure_group/user/user_groups/dir/file/managed_block, lock_get key.path for versions.lock.yaml in flat 2-space YAML, download_verified); main() does exec </dev/null so nothing eats the streamed script; log /srv/ossbot/logs/provision-<ts>.log. PYTHON LAYOUT/APIS for later FEATs: shared constants in ossbot.common.schemas (State, TERMINAL_STATES, OUTBOUND_KINDS, STAGE_ENTRYPOINTS, SANDBOX_JOB_ENTRYPOINTS, DOCKER_FILTER_OPERATIONS, SUBMISSION_CHECKPOINTS) and ossbot.common.control_flags.require_running(control_dir, what) (runner, sandboxd and dockerfilter must call it; tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_control.py parametrizes over these constants). Gatekeeper wiring: ossbot.gatekeeper.context.build_context -> AppContext (approvals, control, snapshots, state_machine, contributions, anomaly, models, outbox, anchors, notify(), operator_fyi(), on_approval_created hook for FEAT-002 cards). ApprovalService: create/set_card_message/mark_part_delivered/issue_card_tokens/approve/confirm/cancel/reject/consume/reissue/set_text_override/invalidate_*; PR-kind bindings re-derive bundle/patch/commit-message hashes via the ArtifactSource protocol (approvals.py); the default NoArtifacts fails closed, so FEAT-002 gitops must supply it. ControlService.checkpoint(what, snapshot_dry_run) is control_checkpoint() (raises Blocked or ModeChanged). StateMachine.transition(cid, from, to, Actor, evidence) returns TransitionResponse; TransitionError(status, code). Outbox: Sender protocol + OutboxWorker (the real Telegram sender lands in FEAT-002); ctx.notify drops (WARNING) while profile.telegram.user_id == 0. Routes /package, /import, /import-bundle return 501. Extra config keys added (all validated, extra=forbid): limits.max_implement_attempts/max_review_rounds/max_change_rounds, text.commit_subject_max, policy sections validation.stack.enabled (Literal false), discovery (proactive Literal false), telegram.mode (Literal single), backup; egress.yaml schema = categories/denied_by_default/sandbox_profiles/host_callers/always_denied (FEAT-003 renderer may extend it). DEVIATIONS (each with reason in the ADR-0003 addendum): the work-account repo pattern was removed from the targets denylist (no personal values), and policy.check_repo blocks repos owned by forbidden logins instead; discovery-requests create a DISCOVERED contribution with source hermes_request; transitions that stop work are allowed while paused or killed; resume detection uses resume-request or new resume.log lines; API models are pydantic strict, except State enum fields (strict=False, needed for FastAPI dict validation). TOOLING NOTES: FastAPI 0.143 wraps included routers (_IncludedRouter.original_router); the route-table test walks them. import-linter contract 'Only ossbot.gatekeeper.submit imports ...github_writer' uses source ossbot.gatekeeper.** plus ignore_imports for submit, with unmatched_ignore_imports_alerting = warn because submit.py does not exist yet; switch it to error in FEAT-002. Tool caches live in /tmp (ruff, mypy); pytest runs with -p no:cacheprovider; nothing is written into the repo. Tests: fixtures in tests/conftest.py (paths, clock, ctx, artifacts, insert_contribution with auto-unique issue numbers, insert_action, packaged_contribution); in-process API client with a fake peer is tests/unit/gatekeeper/api_helpers.client(ctx, uid); 736 unit tests. Not covered here, by plan: git-based approval cases (upstream moves, tampered mirror, bytes posted to fake GitHub) go to FEAT-002; gitleaks on the history to the Phase 1 review. PowerShell quirk: piping wsl.exe output into Select-Object, or chaining it after a PowerShell function definition in one command, sometimes drops the output, so run verification commands unpiped.
